architecture.name: Finite content-bearing construction grammar with exact whole residuals
architecture.target_scope_option: Already admitted FV discovery IT2a f83r.9–17 and f83v.21–33; both complete native units under one model. No fresh extraction is authorized or performed here.
architecture.whole_identity: One exact whole entry or finite explicitly priced typed/contextual overloads. Every repeat uses the same function, including outside its authoring paragraph. No normalization, stem alias or paragraph-dependent glossary.
architecture.formal_input: Frozen cached GDT605/GDT062 views and directed GDT608 constraints are formal evidence, not a semantic parser. Alternative cuts and residuals remain visible.
architecture.semantic_composition: Explicitly hypothesized typed constructors combine ordered arguments into content. Every claimed semantic part changes a result/argument/condition/scope, unless its null effect is separately declared and priced.
architecture.whole_residual: A whole entry retains lexical exceptions or specialization relative to proposed parts. Each residual is charged and never silently erased to make novel forms fit.
architecture.nominal_frames: Finite explicit nominal frames may bind opaque unconfirmed Kind names; each bound name becomes an actual argument of a Spec, relation, assertion or instruction. No unknown-as-name default and no inert catalogue covering all leftover groups.
architecture.discourse: Separate Kind/Spec/Instance and Plan/Event/Result. Name exact current/captured inputs, operation order, closure/stage policy and producer/consumer IDs; compute output before a later written use.
architecture.completion: All groups of the complete chosen native unit receive a licensed typed contribution under one finite grammar. Unknown source/control groups block that unit. Alternates are accounted separately, not counted as independent witnesses.
architecture.frequency: Check existing exact-form profile/distribution against every proposed global role. Broad reuse creates an explanatory obligation, not an automatic POS or frequency-only contradiction.
architecture.avoid_infrastructure: Manual typed derivation plus finite rule/argument table is adequate to author and audit this exploratory model; no new parser, generic executor, decoder or training is needed.
architecture.meaning_ceiling: Coherence or computed consequences do not identify manuscript meanings. Semantically equivalent models may remain useful exploratory candidates.

illustrative_example.text: Combine named materials A and B. Take a portion P of the combined material and place P on surface R. Combine the remainder with named material C. Take a portion Q of that material and place Q on R. Compare the two deposited portions: the later one includes C and the earlier one does not.

paid_toy_constructors.name: NAME
paid_toy_constructors.effect: A, B, C and R are four explicit constants, not occurrence-fitted unknowns.

paid_toy_constructors.name: COMBINE
paid_toy_constructors.effect: Finite set union of stipulated named constituents; no chemistry/efficacy inference.

paid_toy_constructors.name: PORTION
paid_toy_constructors.effect: Fresh ID, parent provenance and copied Contents under an explicit portion-content rule.

paid_toy_constructors.name: PLACE
paid_toy_constructors.effect: Fresh event/deposit, fixed surface owner and immutable constituent snapshot.

paid_toy_constructors.name: COMPARE
paid_toy_constructors.effect: Compute added=later.contents minus earlier.contents, removed=earlier.contents minus later.contents.

illustrative_example.nonseed_consequence: Replacing C by D changes computed added from {C} to {D} using the same constructors; no separate complete-entry/line-result lookup is needed.
